note: NPC definitions for Depths of Vaelmoor (r46). Each NPC has a sprite, role, and dialogue tree. Sprites are palette-locked to the vaelmoor palette.

npcs.name: Eira the Keeper
npcs.description: Blind archivist of the Depths. She can't see the dark — she says it's why she understands it.

npcs.name: Brokk the Unbroken
npcs.description: A seven-foot forge-giant who lost his hammer in the Depths. Forges with his fists now. Gruff, kind, missing three fingers.

npcs.name: Mira of the Tides
npcs.description: Half-drowned cartographer. She breathes water now and can't remember why that ever seemed strange.

npcs.name: The Raven
npcs.description: A skull on a chain that speaks in riddles. Refuses to explain what it is or how it knows.

npcs.name: Lena the Sorrowful
npcs.description: She remembers every run that ever ended here. She'll tell you who killed you, if you ask gently.
